Is UPSC the right career for you? Before you begin preparing, there are four questions worth answering.

In this session, G. Babu Sir, Polity and Governance faculty at LevelUp IAS and a three-time UPSC CSE qualifier, asks students to look beyond the exam and understand what civil service involves, what motivates them, what makes a good civil servant, and how Prelims, Mains and the Personality Test assess different abilities.

The session was organised at Kirori Mal College, Delhi University, by LevelUp IAS in collaboration with Kartavya Civil Society and Legacy – The History Society.

A conversation about making an informed decision before beginning the UPSC journey.

snippet.description:
Preparing for UPSC Mains 2027? Sonia Gupta, who has appeared for the UPSC interview twice, shares a practical tip on what to prioritise before shifting your primary focus to Prelims.

Focus on completing high-priority, relatively static Mains topics such as Polity, Governance, and Social Justice, while continuing Ethics preparation. Plan current-affairs-heavy areas like Science & Technology and Environment strategically, based on your strengths and weaknesses.

Make the most of the time until December with a focused UPSC Mains 2027 preparation strategy.
